howItWorks.subtitle: A fully remote process, completed in days — not weeks.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Complete our secure online form with your personal information and passport details. Takes 5 minutes.

howItWorks.step3Desc: We submit your application to the Portuguese tax authority (AT). Your NIF arrives by email.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Anyone who wants to open a Portuguese bank account, buy or rent property, start a business, or work in Portugal needs a NIF. It is also required for many contracts and purchases.
faq.q2: Do I need to travel to Portugal?
faq.a2: No. Our service is 100% remote. We act as your fiscal representative and handle the entire process on your behalf.
faq.a3: A valid passport (or national ID for EU citizens) and proof of address (utility bill, bank statement, or equivalent) issued within the last 3 months.
faq.a4: Standard service takes 5–7 business days. Express service takes 48–72 hours. Processing times depend on the Portuguese tax authority.
faq.a5: Yes. Your NIF is a permanent tax identification number that does not expire.
